【日期表】机构自己公布、写明这一天的假日表或时刻表。: [Dated list] the agency’s own holiday list or timetable that names this day.
【常设规则】机构长期适用的规则（例如“联邦假日关门”“感恩节按周日班表”），对上: [Standing rule] a rule the agency applies every year (for example “closed on federal holidays” or “Sunday schedule on Thanksgiving”), matched to this year’s date; not an announcement made for this year.
【县政府公告】县政府写明“县办公室这天关门”或“多数县办公室关门”，没有逐个福利: [County notice] the county says “county offices are closed this day” or “most county offices are closed”, without listing each benefits window.
【县假日表】县政府给员工的放假表；各福利窗口当天开不开，要看该部门自己的公告。: [County holiday list] the county’s holiday list for employees; whether a benefits window opens that day is up to the department’s own notice.
【未公布】这次没有找到写明这一天的官方公告，开不开门都还没有官方说法。: [Not published] no official notice naming this day was found; there is no official word yet either way.

图书馆的闭馆表说的是分馆开不开门，没有说网上服务停止。: A library’s closure list says whether branches open; it does not say that online services stop.
公交的常设节日班表，不包括跨年夜加开的班次或免费乘车；那些要看各家针对 2026: A transit agency’s standing holiday schedule does not include extra New Year’s Eve service or free rides; for those, look for each agency’s notice for New Year’s Eve 2026.
